title: $q$-Zeta positivity for root and Ferrers-cell posets
summary: We prove that Chapoton's $q$-Zeta numerator has nonnegative coefficients for the positive-root poset of every finite reduced irreducible crystallographic root system, graded by root height minus one and normalized by Chapoton's prescribed denominator. The same holds for every interval of the root poset with zero adjoined. The key observation is that adjoining a minimum changes the numerator only by the substitution $t\mapsto qt$.
